This '''sentient species''' had long snouts and tusks, similar to a [[Pacithhip]], although the tusks were much shorter and thicker. Behind the trunk and between the tusks was a heavily lipped mouth containing small square, white teeth. The back of their heads were crowned with a row of four spikes with a single row of spikes going down the back of their necks.

Possessing a thin frame, their arms and legs thickened noticeably below the elbow and the knees. Their feet were similar to a [[Gungan]] in that they ended in three short tridactyl toes. Their arms ended in three long, thin black claws, with a fourth as an opposable digit. This did not seem to impede their use of a standard firearm or ability to control a mount.

Several were members of the [[Unidentified caravan|pirate band]] on [[Prine]] that captured [[Ember Chankeli]] and [[Maddie]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
